JUDGMENT WAS REACHED BY STIPULATION. DEFENDANT TAHNEE BARBEE AGREED TO THIS SETTLEMENT BY PHONE. PLAINTIFF JOHN THOMAS SHALL HAVE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF 574-A HICKORY STREET, SAN FRANCISCO. PLAINTIFF THOMAS WAIVES RENTS PER DIEM. EACH SIDE SHALL BEAR THEIR OWN COSTS. A WRIT OF POSSESSION MAY ISSUE AFTER 9-10-95 BUT PHYSICAL EVICTION SHALL BE STAYED UNTIL 9-19-95, 11:59 PM. THERE WILL NOT BE ANY FURTHER STAYS OF EXECUTION INCLUDING THOSE FOR BANKRUPTCY OR MOTIONS TO SET ASIDE JUDGMENT. THE RENTAL AGREEMENT IS FORFEITED. BOTH SIDES ARE RELEASED FROM ALL CAUSES OF ACTION UNDER CP 1542. ANY OF DEFENDANT BARBEE'S POSSESSIONS FOUND ON THE PREMISES AFTER 9-19-95, 11:59PM SHALL BE DEEMED ABANDONED AND SHALL BE DISPOSED BY THE LANDLORD. NO OTHER ADULTS ARE IN POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES. THE SECURITY DEPOSIT, IN THIS MATTER SHALL REMAIN WITH PLAINTIFF THOMAS. IF DEFENDANT BARBEE VACATES VOLUNTARILY BY AGREED DATE, PLAINTIFF THOMAS SHALL SET ASIDE AND VACATE JUDGMENT WITH PREJUDICE.
